g.text: Anthropic Managed Agent Public Configuration Model
Research map of the 2026-08-16 field baseline; exact fields are maintained in tables.
Create requires name and model. Update version is an optional optimistic lock (2026-09-14).
Maximums: 128 effective tools, 500 skills across a Session, 20 roster Agents.
PermissionPolicy shows the original two policy examples; it is not the current full union.
